title: A minimizing cone with vanishing boundary is stationary and radially tangent
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C), and a cone (IsConeCurrent C), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) represent C. Then (a) R.firstVariation X = 0 for every C¹ vector field X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support, and (b) for R.measure-almost every x, p_{T_x}(x) = x, where T_x := approxTangentPlane n M x and p_{T_x} is the orthogonal projection onto T_x (starProjection).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x
